entities.summary: Jamelle William Hagins is an American professional basketball player with a 13-year international career spanning top leagues in France, Greece, Italy, Turkey, Belgium, Poland, Dubai, and Tunisia. A seasoned power forward and center, Hagins has won championships in Italy’s Serie A and the Turkish Basketball Super League, and has reached the Final Four in both the FIBA Europe Cup and the Basketball Champions League.
